The most recent sources point to **Next.js 16.4.2** as the latest stable release, though the sources differ slightly.

- **npm (most current):** The npm package page lists Latest version: 16.4.2, last published: a day ago. Its tag list also marks 16.4.2 as `latest`.
- **Release history site:** This source lists 16.4.1 as current, released as part of the 16 release on 15 October 2026. It likely predates the 16.4.2 publish.
- **Older snapshot:** versionlog.com shows 16.4.0, released 06 Oct 2026, which is outdated relative to npm.
- **Feature release:** Next.js 16.4 was Next.js 16.4 adds faster development, smaller caches and production bundles, React 19.3 support, per Releasebot.
- **Prior minor:** The official blog covers Next.js 16.3, dated 3 Aug 2026.

Because npm is the most recent source and matches the `latest` tag, 16.4.2 is the best answer. The other sites lag behind it. Running `npm show next version` would confirm it directly.

content.text:
The latest stable Next.js is most likely **16.4.2**, but I couldn't confirm its exact release date.

- **Version:** The npm page lists 16.4.2 as the `latest` tag.
- **Release date:** npm showed it as published "a day ago", which puts it around 15 October 2026. That is my reading of a relative timestamp, not a date any source stated.
- **16.4 line:** 16.4.0 came out on 6 October 2026, according to versionlog.com. Releasebot says 16.4 adds faster development, smaller caches and production bundles, and React 19.3 support.
- **Sources disagree:** Some sources still show 16.4.1 or 16.4.0 as current. I think they were out of date when I looked, since npm is the most direct source.

To check the version yourself, run `npm show next version`. `npm view next time --json` also gives exact publish timestamps.

Sources:
- [next - npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/next)
- [next - npm versions](https://www.npmjs.com/package/next?activeTab=versions)
- [Next.js Latest Version - Release History, LTS & EOL](https://versionlog.com/nextjs/)
- [Next.js Updates by Vercel - October 2026 - Releasebot](https://releasebot.io/updates/vercel/next-js)
- [Next.js 16.3](https://nextjs.org/blog/next-16-3)
- [Vercel Next.js releases, versions & EOL dates](https://www.versio.io/en/product-release-end-of-life-eol-vercel-nextjs.html)
